scope: Retention permits bounded optimization only; repair requires front-wheel every-tread support, sustained four-wheel upright top support, no falls or route stalls, post-entry speed, compact flat stance and separate C-idle/moving yaw gates. Rear-wheel tread sequences are recorded without a hard gate. Fixed clean MuJoCo cases are not real-robot acceptance. Thresholds are prospective and versioned, not evidence of a successful model.
